scope: Select Indonesian strategic investment entities; not a comprehensive beneficial ownership register

levels: Direct equity: sourced legal shareholders and percentages
Corporate chain: explicitly disclosed parent/subsidiary relationships
Control: separately disclosed voting, joint-control, operating or shareholder-agreement arrangements
Natural-person beneficial owner: label verified ONLY after company-specific primary registry evidence with cross-check
methodology.notice: Indonesian AHU's beneficial ownership records are filed by companies or reporting agents and AHU notes it does not verify submitted information. Registry availability is not independent verification. Do not identify executives, ministers or owners of listed-company stakes as BO without direct evidence.
methodology.recency: Source snapshots retain their own dates; entries older than 12 months should be rechecked.

direct_shareholders.name: PT Indonesia Papua Metal Dan Mineral (PT IPMM)

entities.ownership_chain: PT IPMM was reported 100% MIND ID-owned at 31 December 2025, yielding a 51.24% MIND ID group position. This is a corporate equity chain, not an individually verified beneficial owner.
entities.control: FCX is described as operating shareholder with rights to appoint a majority of members of the operating committee. Economic equity majority and operational governance differ.

beneficial_owner.reason: No company-specific, cross-checked natural-person BO record incorporated; state ownership and listed-company ownership do not identify an individual BO.

entities.risk: Concentrate supply, smelter restart and shareholder operating rights may affect project execution independently of nominal equity.
entities.monitor: Latest audited share register, PT IPMM ownership, ownership rights, FCX operating arrangements, smelter availability.

entities.ownership_chain: Vale states MIND ID and Vale Canada exercise joint control. A 34% largest shareholding is not sole control. Company identifies Vale Canada as belonging to Vale Base Metals.
entities.control: Joint control disclosed by company; not inferred from simple ownership threshold.

beneficial_owner.reason: Controlling legal entities are disclosed but individual ultimate beneficial owners have not been independently established.

entities.risk: Joint-governance arrangements, capital commitments, industrial power and environmental approvals are distinct control and delivery issues.
entities.monitor: Quarterly substantial shareholdings, shareholders' agreement changes, IGP Pomalaa and Morowali milestones.

entities.ownership_chain: ANTAM reports MIND ID as immediate parent and Danantara as ultimate parent incorporated in Indonesia, controlled by the Republic of Indonesia. A separate Series A Dwiwarna state share must not be confused with Series B economic percentages.
entities.control: MIND ID direct controlling shareholder in reported period; state strategic rights are a separate layer.

beneficial_owner.reason: State and SOE corporate ownership is known; no natural-person BO is inferred from officeholders.

entities.risk: SOE portfolio control, partner-specific project SPVs and ministerial authorizations are separate mechanisms.
entities.monitor: 2025 annual report and 2026 updated shareholder registers, IBC and battery SPV equity allocation.

entities.ownership_chain: The IMIP corporate FAQ lists three direct shareholders. The ultimate owners of intermediate companies and ultimate natural-person beneficial owners are NOT established by this statement.
entities.control: Direct percentages disclosed; cannot infer a single controlling natural person, governance rights or ultimate voting control without additional evidence.

beneficial_owner.reason: No cross-checked upstream shareholder registry or AHU beneficial-owner record available for this analysis.

entities.risk: Industry-park manager and individual tenant project SPVs are separate legal entities. Do not attribute all tenant investment, power capacity or emissions to IMIP equity owners.
entities.monitor: Updated shareholders, industrial park licenses, tenant-specific ownership, energy and environmental permits.

entities.ownership_chain: PT Freeport Indonesia is majority shareholder in PT Smelting. Its own shareholder chain is separately documented under PTFI; look-through arithmetic does not automatically translate to operating control.
entities.control: FCX states Mitsubishi Materials operates PT Smelting facilities despite holding a 34% stake.

beneficial_owner.reason: No separate individual BO filing was independently reviewed.

entities.risk: Management and operating rights are not identical to majority equity; concentrate supply affects utilization.
entities.monitor: Shareholder register updates, operator agreement and production utilization.

entities.evidence_tier: Project company identification; equity percentages unverified
entities.ownership_chain: Vale identifies PT KNI as the HPAL project venture with Vale, Huayou and Ford. No current ownership percentages are supplied in the selected project disclosure; partner participation does not determine equity percentage.

beneficial_owner.reason: Current direct share register and natural-person BO not verified.

entities.risk: Verify venture-level cap table before any attribution of financing or project revenue to a parent company.
entities.monitor: JV shareholders, project equity subscription, financing close and commissioning.

entities.ownership_chain: MIND ID is the majority Series B holder. The Republic of Indonesia additionally holds five Series A Dwiwarna shares; those special shares are a separate rights class and cannot be measured by percentage alone.
entities.control: Majority corporate ownership through MIND ID; direct control rights and operational authorizations are not interchangeable.

beneficial_owner.reason: Company share register does not identify any individual natural person as ultimate BO; state officeholders are not assigned as BO.

entities.risk: Coal demand, HBA and domestic-market obligation, power-sector offtake and diversified downstream capital affect operations.
entities.monitor: Post-2025 capital structure, related-party exposures, coal offtake and energy-transition commitments.

sources.label: PTBA annual report 2025 — shareholder structure p.159

entities.evidence_tier: Company shareholder disclosure; underlying register undated
entities.ownership_chain: PHI's direct equity holders are PHE and Pertamina Pedeve. The group's ultimate institutional ownership and legal special rights require separate parent-level disclosures.
entities.control: PHE is PHI's disclosed controlling shareholder at the entity level; PHI subsidiary PSC operational rights must be checked at asset-specific level.

beneficial_owner.reason: No company-specific natural-person BO record or current parent chain ownership verification incorporated.

entities.risk: Oil and gas investment exposure should be assessed by PSC contract, contractor operator, approval and cost recovery rules, not simply corporate holding equity.
entities.monitor: PHE group annual report, PSC operator mapping, upstream work program and budget, field-level FID.

entities.evidence_tier: Official Telkom transaction disclosure and shareholder register
entities.ownership_chain: The September 2025 Telkom public disclosure lists PT Danantara Asset Management holding 52.09% of Series B shares and the Republic of Indonesia holding one Series A Dwiwarna special-rights share.
entities.control: Distinguish Danantara's economic equity interests, the state Dwiwarna share, Telkom corporate governance and Telkom subsidiary-level data-center JV shareholdings.

beneficial_owner.status: Company reports an AHU BO designation; independently unverified
beneficial_owner.reason: Telkom disclosure states AHU record reports its Board of Directors as controller/BO, but provides no independently verified person-specific BO determination suitable for this registry.

entities.risk: Group shareholding does not establish equity percentages in NeutraDC, data-center ventures or individual campuses; verify each SPV.
entities.monitor: 2026 dated major-shareholder filing, Telkom subsidiary ownership, data-center project capacity and investment realization.

sources.label: Telkom disclosure / shareholder register 30 Sep 2025, p.12 and BO statement p.14
